Significant increases in speed from changes below. Also some new docs to complement the changes.
These relate to #31

## Content
- LoopVectorization.jl
- Decomposition now stores inv(factorization) too (so predictions are now just matrix-vector multiplications
- removed user batching in favour of Tullio's inbuild memory management.
- only build features once and share between predict mean and predict cov.
- add a buffer for predictive_cov! in predict! to reduce allocations.
- new docs for performance tips
